items.title: Sheafifying the differentials of a morphism of schemes on the small etale site gives the module of differentials of the morphism of etale sites
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces), section on the sheaf of differentials of a morphism of schemes on the small etale site

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma compares two objects attached to a morphism of schemes f : X -> Y, the sheaf (Omega_{X/Y})^a on the small etale site of X and the module Omega_{X_etale/Y_etale} defined on ringed sites, and asserts a canonical isomorphism compatible with universal derivations (statement lines 860-877). The proof builds the two comparison maps from opposite directions: c from etale-local identification of the values of (Omega_{X/Y})^a and the universal property of the module of differentials, c'' by restricting a derivation to the small Zariski site and taking an adjoint along id_{small,etale,Zar} (proof lines 880-936). The non-routine part is that the second direction has to pass through the Zariski site, where derivations are classical, and then back to the etale site by adjunction; the final check that the two composites are the identity is explicitly left to the reader (proof line 941) and is routine. Hence H2.
